name: Hog Test
author: brodgar
description: Soft CPU-budget test addon (D-018 layer 2). DORMANT by default; arm it (see main.lua) so it burns ~15ms every OnUpdate — over the per-tick budget but under the hard per-call cap — and the engine auto-disables it for the session, with a warning on its row in Options -> AddOns. Keep it disarmed/disabled during normal play.
